summary: You presented a clear mission concept and strong STK modelling for monitoring the Great Barrier Reef. While the Introduction effectively justified the single-satellite architecture, the technical design contained a conceptual error regarding retrograde launch physics, an incomplete sentence in the EOL section, and generic conclusions. Addressing orbital mechanics nuances, submitting software files, and adopting professional referencing standards will bring your report to an Accomplished level.

Proofread technical descriptions carefully to ensure sentences in the EOL section are fully completed and attach your STK scenario files.
Replace raw URL and Wikipedia citations with peer-reviewed literature formatted consistently according to standard engineering styles.
